officialSources.observation: Official Bihar Government/NIC BhuNaksha viewer. Current public HTML and JavaScript expose same-host REST selection routes, ScalarDatahandler plot lookup, and WMS map routes. The hierarchy identifies Begusarai district, Birpur circle and Birpur(435) mauza.
Official Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms Department page links Bhu-Naksha, revenue records and survey services.
Official Bihar land-record report lists Begusarai, Birpur and BIRPUR PURBI / वीरपुर.
Official Bihar Bhumi gateway lists भू-नक्शा as the revenue-map viewing portal.
